issuer.console.sigma_title: Credentials from the IN Groupe issuer
issuer.console.sigma_pid: Creates a real credential offer through the IN Groupe issuer’s offer API. The data comes from the issuer’s own records for the chosen sample user. Your wallet then fetches the credential from IN Groupe.
issuer.console.sigma_note: The issuer returns a 6-digit transaction code, which your wallet asks for.
offer.fallback_note: The IN Groupe issuer does not offer this attestation, so the local demo issuer issues it.
issuer.console.sigma_advanced_hint: The issuer fills the credential from its own records for these identifiers. An unknown identifier produces an empty credential. Ask the issuer which ones exist.
portal.title: Issuer portal
portal.intro: Issue credentials to your EU Wallet from the IN Groupe issuer’s sample records, using the pre-authorised code flow (OpenID4VCI).
portal.select.title: Use case selection
portal.select.label: Choose a use case
portal.none: No use case is available: the connected issuer’s credential catalogue could not be read, or it offers none of these credentials.
portal.desc.title: Description
portal.desc.body: The pre-authorised code flow gives credentials to your EU Wallet through a simple QR code scan or link. The issuer creates a credential offer with a one-time code; your wallet connects to the issuer, redeems the code and receives the credential, with no browser sign-in needed.
portal.step1: Select a use case and a sample record.
portal.step2: Create the offer: a QR code, a link and a one-time code appear.
portal.step3: Scan the QR code or open the link with your EU Wallet.
portal.step4: Enter the transaction code when the wallet asks for it.
portal.users.intro: These are the issuer’s own sample records. The issuer fills the credential from the record you choose.

admin.result.none: No record in the authentic source matches these values.
admin.result.multi: Several records match these values. Choose one.
admin.result.available: Records available in the authentic source
admin.result.snapshot: The issuer’s record list could not be read live, so a saved copy of its sample records was used.
admin.sigma_note: The IN Groupe issuer issues only what is in its own records. Your values are therefore checked against those records, and the offer is created for the matching person.

verify.elsewhere.title: Verification complete
verify.elsewhere.body: Your wallet has shared the requested data. Please continue in the browser or on the screen where you started.
admin.reuse.title: Credential reuse policy
admin.reuse.hint: Whether the local issuer tells wallets (like the IN Groupe issuer does) how copies of a credential may be reused. Without it a wallet treats every copy as single-use. Applies to credentials downloaded after the change, and is forgotten when the app restarts.
admin.reuse.current_on: Declared: per relying party, rotating batch of 5.
admin.reuse.saved_off: Reuse policy is no longer declared.
admin.batch.title: Credentials per request (batch)
admin.batch.hint: How many copies of a credential the local issuer hands out per request. 1 means batch issuance is not declared (the specification only allows a declared batch of 2 or more) and a single proof is accepted. Applies to credentials downloaded after the change, and is forgotten when the app restarts.
